words.t: エンサイクロペディア
words.lemma: エンサイクロペディア
words.reading: エンサイクロペディア

words.gram: godan verb, masu-stem (役に立つ = be useful)

lines.trans: 'Love,' 'good,' 'hello'—you just memorize short words like these.
With just that, you can speak with foreigners.
If it's just those three, even I could probably memorize them.
Because even an elementary school student can memorize them.
See you again.

meanings.note: Humble (kenjougo) equivalent of する, used in polite business and apologetic expressions.

examples.text: すぐにご連絡いたします。
examples.trans: I will contact you right away.

meanings.note: Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.
Short for かもしれない; expresses possibility or uncertainty.
Follows a clause to give a reason or reassuring explanation.

examples.trans: Because it is close, I walk.

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

meanings.note: Refers to facts, matters, or affairs rather than physical objects (もの).

examples.text: 仕事のことを話します。

meanings.note: Directly modifies a noun near the speaker (この店, この辺, この部分).

examples.text: この本は人気があります。

meanings.en: polite auxiliary in ありがとうございます
meanings.note: Survives in modern speech chiefly in ございます (present) and ございました (past) after ありがとう and おめでとう.

examples.text: ありがとうございます。
ありがとうございました。
examples.trans: Thank you very much (for what just concluded).

meanings.note: Honorific term for someone else's husband or the master of a house/shop.

examples.text: ご主人はいらっしゃいますか。
ご主人、お帰りなさいませ。

meanings.note: Very common colloquial pronunciation/variant of すみません.

examples.text: すいません、ちょっと通してください。
examples.trans: Excuse me, please let me through.

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.

meanings.en: in that way; that is so
meanings.note: そうですか ('Is that so? / I see') calmly acknowledges news.

examples.text: そうですか、わかりました。
あのそう-様態を見ます。

meanings.note: Conjunction introducing a solution or next step based on the preceding situation.

examples.text: そこで新しい方法を試しました。
examples.trans: So, we tried a new method.

examples.text: そこでこの道具が役に立ちます。
examples.trans: That is where this tool comes in handy.

meanings.en: that (near the listener or just mentioned)
meanings.note: Must always precede a noun (その椅子 'that chair').

meanings.en: and so; because of that; with that
meanings.note: Conjunction indicating a result or asking 'and then what happened?'.

examples.text: それでどうなりましたか。
それで問題が解決しました。
examples.trans: With that, the problem was solved.

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Limits the preceding noun or phrase to that item alone.

examples.text: これだけお願いします。

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

できる.gloss: be built; open; be able to

meanings.en: come into existence; be completed; can do
meanings.note: With buildings or stores (店ができる), means a new shop has been built or opened.

examples.text: 駅前に新しいカフェができました。
examples.trans: A new café opened in front of the station.

examples.text: 日本語が少しできます。
examples.trans: I can speak a little Japanese.

meanings.note: Polite presumptive form of copula だ; with rising intonation, seeks agreement.

examples.text: 明日は晴れるでしょう。
examples.trans: It will probably be sunny tomorrow.

meanings.note: Polite sentence-ending counterpart of plain だ.

cells: ではありません / じゃありません

meanings.en: whichever (after question word); or something like
meanings.note: After どれ (どれでも) means 'any one at all'; after a noun (店でも) suggests an example ('a shop or something').

examples.text: いつでも来てください。
お茶でも飲みませんか。
examples.trans: Won't you have tea or something?

meanings.note: Degree adverb modifying adjectives and adverbs.

examples.text: 今日はとても暑いです。

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').
Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.

なら.gloss: if it is; in the case of

meanings.note: Conditional topic marker placed right after a noun or pronoun (あなたなら 'if it were you').

examples.text: あなたならどうしますか？
examples.trans: If it were you, what would you do?

examples.text: 明日なら時間があります。
examples.trans: If it is tomorrow, I have time.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.
Used both to answer yes politely and when handing an item to someone.
Used in everyday farewells like またね, また明日, and また会いましょう.

examples.text: また明日会いましょう。

meanings.note: Replaces は, が, or を to add 'also' or 'too'.

examples.trans: Please give me this one too.

examples.text: あそこも新しい店です。
examples.trans: Over there is a new shop too.

meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.

エンサイクロペディア.lemma: エンサイクロペディア

meanings.note: Loanword from English 'encyclopedia' (Japanese equivalent: 百科事典).

examples.text: このエンサイクロペディアはとても役立ちます。
部屋にエンサイクロペディアが並んでいます。
examples.trans: Encyclopedias are lined up in the room.

オンリーワン.gloss: one of a kind; only one

meanings.note: Loanword from English 'only one', used to praise someone as irreplaceable.

examples.text: あなたはオンリーワンの存在です。
examples.trans: You are one of a kind.

examples.text: オンリーワンの商品を作ります。
examples.trans: We will create a one-of-a-kind product.

meanings.note: Loanword from English 'aura'.

examples.text: 彼には特別なオーラがあります。
すごいオーラを感じます。

meanings.note: Loanword from English 'good', used as an enthusiastic exclamation.
Loanword greeting from English 'hello'.

examples.text: まずはハローから始めましょう。

meanings.note: Playful loanword transliteration of English 'beautiful'.

examples.text: 今日の夕日はビューティフォーだ。
ビューティフォーな景色ですね。

meanings.note: Loanword from English 'love'.

examples.text: ラブとピースが大切です。
世界中にラブを届けます。
examples.trans: We deliver love all over the world.

meanings.note: Native Japanese counter for three general items.

examples.text: 単語を三つ覚えました。
みかんが三つあります。

meanings.note: Polite volitional 会いましょう in また会いましょう means 'let us meet again'.

examples.trans: I meet a friend at the station.

examples.text: また来週会いましょう。

meanings.note: Used among friends and peers by men; switch to 私 or 僕 in formal settings.
Noun.

examples.text: 毎日十個の単語を覚える。
この単語の意味が分かりません。
examples.trans: I don't know the meaning of this word.

meanings.note: Noun (also written 取引) meaning commercial trade or dealings.

examples.text: 海外との取り引きが増えました。
examples.trans: Business dealings with overseas have increased.

examples.text: 新しい会社と取り引きを始めます。
examples.trans: We will start doing business with a new company.

meanings.note: Intransitive ichidan verb meaning something increases in number or amount.

examples.text: 最近お客さんが増えました。
仕事が増えて忙しくなりました。
examples.trans: Work increased and I got busy.

meanings.note: Combines 外国 (foreign country) and 人 (person).

examples.text: 外国人と英語で話しました。
examples.trans: I spoke with a foreigner in English.

examples.text: この町には外国人が多いです。
examples.trans: There are many foreigners in this town.

meanings.note: Combines 小学 (elementary school) and 生 (student).

examples.text: 小学生でも分かります。
examples.trans: Even an elementary school student can understand.

examples.text: 妹は今年小学生になりました。
examples.trans: My younger sister became an elementary school student this year.

meanings.note: In 役に立つ, means 'to be useful / come in handy'.

examples.text: この辞書はとても役に立ちます。
何かお役に立てますか。
examples.trans: Can I be of any help?

meanings.note: Adverbial form 早く urges someone to hurry up.

examples.trans: I woke up early in the morning.

meanings.note: Temporal noun often used adverbially.
Refers to countries outside Japan.

examples.text: 海外旅行に行きたいです。
examples.trans: I want to go on an overseas trip.

examples.text: 海外との取り引きが増えています。

meanings.note: Na-adjective.

examples.text: 特別な理由はありません。

meanings.note: I-adjective describing length or duration.

examples.text: 短い単語を覚えましょう。

examples.trans: The days are short in winter.

meanings.note: Godan verb; in 役に立つ, means 'to be useful'.

examples.text: ここに立ってください。
この経験はきっと役に立ちます。
examples.trans: This experience will surely be useful.

meanings.note: Past 覚えた means 'I have memorized it' (and therefore now know it).

examples.text: 新しい言葉を覚えます。

meanings.note: 話してきます combines 話して ('talk and') with きます ('come back') to mean 'I will go talk to them and return'.

examples.text: 少し社長と話してきます。
examples.trans: I will go talk with the president for a bit.

examples.text: ゆっくり話しましょう。

meanings.note: Verbal noun; 説明する means 'to explain'.

examples.text: 詳しい説明をお願いします。
